notes.title: Last Village is Now Available
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594340/Last_Village/

After many months of development, the game was released.
Plunge into the atmosphere of a destroyed village under the control of sinister alien invaders.
Exciting adventures and exciting battles await you.

Good luck in battle!

notes.title: Update 1.160
notes.content:
- Bug fixes.
- Code optimization.
- Minor additions.
- A good ending run with more 57 batteries.
- Added Turkish translation by Checkpoint Localization http://cplocalization.com
- Added Portuguese translation by José Victor Araujo.
